question: Ravana Phadi cave and Durga Temple at Aihole portray the architectural style of which dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chalukya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Ravanaphadi Cave,** a sixth-century cave temple constructed during the reign of the **Early Western Chalukyas** around 550 CE in Aihole (formerly Aryapura or Ayyavole), is a significant monument in the evolution of early medieval Deccan architecture.
